tools.name: find_math_lesson
tools.description: Find a lesson on Mathorio, a free math site (arithmetic, fractions, decimals, percentages, algebra, geometry, statistics, probability, trigonometry, pre-calculus). Returns the definition and key points in plain English and a link to the full lesson with worked step-by-step examples, common mistakes

tools.name: daily_math_challenge
tools.description: Mathorio's Daily Math Challenge: one new problem every day, the same for everyone, three tries and a streak. Returns today's problem (without the answer) and the link to solve it. Use for a class warm up or a daily brain teaser.
